objective: Test three distinct, causal intraday mechanisms using a $100 account without reusing any previously rejected SPY, UPRO, SPXU, or SH signal family.
evidence_warning: The repository has already exposed the researcher to 2021-2026 results from many other hypotheses. The 2024-2025 partition is a secondary holdout for these exact rules, but no historical partition is a pristine independent sample for the overall research program. Any survivor requires future paper validation.

data.consolidated_execution_audit: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m where available

shared_signal_definitions.spy_minute_log_return: log(current minute close / prior minute close), using 09:30-15:59 regular-session bars only
shared_signal_definitions.realized_variance: sum of squared SPY minute log returns for a completed session
shared_signal_definitions.downside_variance_share: sum of squared negative SPY minute log returns divided by realized variance
shared_signal_definitions.rolling_baseline: median realized variance of the prior 20 eligible completed sessions; no current-session values
shared_signal_definitions.entry_time: 09:31 observed ask on the next eligible session
shared_signal_definitions.missing_quote: cancel the affected trade; never forward-fill

quiet_variance_carry.economic_claim: The positive equity risk premium is more compatible with 3x exposure after a quiet session, while high realized variance increases volatility drag and crash risk. Buy UPRO only when the prior session's realized variance is no greater than its trailing 20-session median; otherwise hold cash.

downside_variance_handoff.economic_claim: A high-variance session dominated by downside semivariance represents persistent deleveraging pressure rather than ordinary volatility. Buy SPXU on the next session only when prior realized variance is above its trailing median and downside variance share is above 0.5; buy UPRO otherwise.

paired_variance_harvest.economic_claim: A constant-dollar mix of daily +3x and -3x exposure can harvest intraday oscillation by selling part of the relative winner and buying the relative loser, without predicting market direction.
paired_variance_harvest.entry: At 09:31 buy $50 UPRO and $50 SPXU at observed asks.
paired_variance_harvest.rebalance: At 12:31, value both legs at observed bid, sell the overweight leg at bid, and buy the underweight leg at ask until both legs have equal liquidation value after the rebalance.
paired_variance_harvest.exit: At 15:55 sell both legs at observed bids.
paired_variance_harvest.position: 100% gross split between two long ETF legs
paired_variance_harvest.expected_frequency: one round trip per session plus one rebalance on sessions requiring it

benchmarks.passive_spy: Price-only fractional SPY from the first 09:30 open to the final 15:59 close over identical dates
benchmarks.always_upro_intraday: Buy UPRO at 09:31 ask and sell at 15:55 bid every eligible session

diagnostic_extension: 2026-01-02 through 2026-07-24; not described as pristine because other repository research has already inspected 2026

holdout_gate.rule: Only candidates passing every development gate may be called development survivors.
requirements: positive observed-BBO fixed-notional P&L in 2024 and 2025 separately
ending cash above price-only SPY over 2024-2025
positive after one extra cent per share at every fill
positive after removing the five best holdout sessions

multiple_testing.policy: Report every candidate. Do not select a variant by aggregate P&L. No parameter grid, threshold search, clock search, weekday filter, direction deletion, or strategy combination is permitted.

cash_settlement_warning: The economic simulation assumes the full account can be redeployed each eligible session. A literal US cash account could not always do this under historical T+2 settlement and may still face good-faith-violation constraints under T+1. Operational feasibility must be assessed separately.
